description.en: Ontology module for representing core textile product data relevant to EU Digital Product Passports, including textile product classes, textile apparel scope concepts, fibre composition structures, and controlled SKOS vocabularies for textile apparel product types and fibre types aligned with the JRC preparatory study on textiles.

comments.en: Fibre, yarn and fabric are modelled as textile products. When one product is intended to be incorporated into another, dpp:isComponentOf expresses the component role; the ontology does not create a separate intermediate-product class.

bibliographicCitation.value: EU DPP Textile Core Ontology. Version 1.1.2.

modellingNote.value: TextileApparel is a final textile product category for apparel and apparel accessories. The supplied EU DPP Core snapshot does not declare a separate FinalProduct class, so final-product status remains a local textile distinction under dpp:Product. It is narrower than TextileProduct and should not be confused with the whole textile product domain.
